channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gerald Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gerald Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Gerald Green
item.description:
Salman Ali:Stephen Silas on what Gerald Green brings to Rockets coaching staff:

“He is one of the most genuine people you could ever meet. Having someone with that positivity and with that experience and mentality is good for our group.”

Stephen Silas on Gerald Green, Oct 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Gerald Green
item.description:
Salman Ali:Rafael Stone:

“Gerald and I have talked a lot over the past couple days. And it's a little bitter sweet. Like I told him, I had to retire from playing when I was 22. So he had a lot better career than I did.”

Rafael Stone on Gerald Green, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Gerald Green
item.description:
Salman Ali:Silas on waiving Green (continued):

“Hopefully he gets an opportunity to come back here or keep playing. He represents everything that we're all about.”

Stephen Silas on Gerald Green, Dec 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green
item.description:
Mike D’Antoni on Gerald Green:

“He’s out all year I think. That’s too bad. I hate it for him.”

Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green, Oct 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green, James Ennis, De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni:

“I think James Ennis can be really good. I think people are downplaying him. Gerald Green will take another step forward. The De'Anthony Melton kid looked really good... If we're going to beat Golden State...you gotta take some chances... I think the worst we're going to be is great.”

Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green, James Ennis, De'Anthony Melton, Jul 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza, Gerald Green
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza and Gerald Green suspended for 2 games:

“We shouldn't have initiated, shouldn't have gone in (the Clippers locker room).”

Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza, Gerald Green, Jan 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green
item.description:
David Hardisty:D'Antoni on Gerald Green:

“Thank goodness we got him. He's not been just good. He's been really good.”

Mike D'Antoni on Gerald Green, Jan 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gerald Green
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Stevens on Green:

“He's a guy that can score. He's been doing it a long time. He was fun to have around. He's a big reason we advanced out of the first round.”

Brad Stevens on Gerald Green, Dec 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Gerald Green
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I think that learning that early as opposed to learning that late has helped me out in my career, people like Gerald Green who has been in my ear from the beginning,he’s been in the league a lot and he’s been in the league, out of the league, but he’s always made an effort to come talk to me, and he’s been a perfect example for me, so I learned a lot from him about how to be ready and how to take advantage of every situation because you don’t know how situations might end up.”

Jaylen Brown on Gerald Green, May 19, 2017. Source: WEEI.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Isaiah Thomas, Gerald Green
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Lue on Gerald Green in lineup:

“With us trying to get the ball out of Isaiah's hands, getting another shooter on the floor is smart.”

Tyronn Lue on Isaiah Thomas, Gerald Green, May 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Al Horford, Gerald Green
item.description:
“We got a big addition in Al Horford. Got my guy Gerald Green coming back to Boston,”

Isaiah Thomas on Al Horford, Gerald Green, Aug 14, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Gerald Green
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Spoelstra on Gerald Green's role:

“We’ll work him back in at a healthy rate. What that will be on Tuesday? I don’t know right now.”

Erik Spoelstra on Gerald Green, Nov 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Gerald Green
item.description:
Asked later if he believes Green can be trusted to stay in line moving forward, Riley responded:

“I just believe that we can [count on Gerald moving forward]. I’ve been around this game for 48 years and he’s a really great kid, great athlete, can really shoot the ball. He’s explosive and we’re going to need him, and I think he’s going to show that to us.”

Pat Riley on Gerald Green, Nov 11, 2015. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Gerald Green
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Erik Spoelstra:

“We hope to have an announcement on Gerald by the end of the night.”

Erik Spoelstra on Gerald Green, Nov 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Gerald Green
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Spoelstra on Gerald Green:

“He's healthy and safe. I mentioned that the other day. I speak with him daily. There's no other update.”

Erik Spoelstra on Gerald Green, Nov 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Gerald Green, Goran Dragic
item.description:
“We have it set up now where we have a decent amount in the summer of 2015.We have some key free agents this summer in Goran Dragic and Gerald Green that we'd like to re-sign. We'll see how it goes. Right now our main focus is trying to win as many games as we can, trying to make the playoffs. If we do get there, win in the playoffs. After the season's over, we'll re-evaluate and see where we are in terms of the draft and free agency.”

Ryan McDonough on Gerald Green, Goran Dragic, Jan 29, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Gerald Green
item.description:
“And so are we [the coaching staff]. It's not just those three guys — we have Gerald Green at the guard position also. And everyone goes, ‘Ehh, we can just slide him over to the 3 spot,' but then we have P.J. Tucker and Marcus Morris.”

Jeff Hornacek on Gerald Green, Nov 26, 2014. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Nate Robinson on Gerald Green, Dennis Rodman, Julius Erving, Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
“A guy like Gerald Green controls his hops and his jumps are for a purpose. Julius Erving had big hands. He was always moving the ball all around; he made it look like magic in the air. Then you have explosive dunkers who jump high and dunk hard like Dominique Wilkins. Me? I'm an energy jumper. My jumping ability is more like an explosive Dennis Rodman, and since I'm shorter, it looks crazy. I'm just a guy out there who's trying to show the world what I can do. Not too many 5-9 guys can dunk like I can.”

Nate Robinson on Gerald Green, Dennis Rodman, Julius Erving, Dominique Wilkins, Jan 18, 2013. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Gerald Green
item.description:
Doc on Green:

“I think there’s still a very good chance for Gerald Green. He was just so young when he was here. He’s skilled. I think people just looked at Gerald and saw this freak athlete that won the Dunk Contest. Gerald can make shots. He can really shoot the basketball. He just hadn’t been taught how to play basketball, and it’s a gift. So I’m just hoping it works out for him. It would be a terrific story.”

Doc Rivers on Gerald Green, Mar 3, 2012. Source: Sulia.
